```markdown
## Logging

The rapid-mcp server uses a configurable logging system. Configure via environment variables:

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `RAPID_LOGGING_DISABLED` | `0` | Set to `1` to disable all logging |
| `RAPID_LOG_LEVEL` | `debug` | Minimum level: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` |
| `RAPID_LOG_TIMESTAMPS` | `0` | Set to `1` to include ISO timestamps |

Logging is automatically disabled when `NODE_ENV=production`.

### Usage in Code

```typescript
import { logger } from './utils/logger';

const log = logger('myComponent');
log.debug('Debug message');
log.info('Info message');
log.warn('Warning');
log.error('Error:', err);
```
```
